review_scope: Offline ML contracts, dataset generation, three mandatory candidates and seeds, explanations, immutable repository, release/OCI, consumer, fault, performance, supply and soak gates

findings.title: Repository was made read-only before child creation
findings.resolution: Populate the repository under owner-only writable modes, then recursively freeze version/model/repository directories and all members before publication.

findings.title: Explanation builder reused one contract digest set across candidates
findings.resolution: Bind every explanation to the feature, label and output-adapter digests embedded and independently verified in that exact candidate ONNX metadata.

findings.title: First release wheel comparison observed stale build-state drift
findings.resolution: Remove only exact setuptools-generated build and egg-info paths before both SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH-pinned builds; both wheel bytes and SHA-256 now match.

findings.title: SIGKILL could leave a private staging directory
findings.resolution: Write a PID plus process-start ownership marker, never publish partial output, and recover only a dead process exact-target staging tree on the next run.

findings.title: Wolfi final runtime produced different immutable model identity than the release process
findings.resolution: Retain the vulnerability-clean distroless Debian glibc runtime, copy only exact-digest zlib and libffi files from a pinned zero-vulnerability Wolfi source image, and make release-to-OCI model, closure, and archive identity equality a required OCI gate.
